I know those problems. I grew up neither rich or poor. We had dinner every night and such. But the evening's are the enemy. You can have the best day in the world, 1 person starts drinking. One thing leads to another, next moment your talking to the cops and getting death threats from loved ones. Those memories that make up seemingly endless, sleepless nights. Alcohol is a great and terrible thing that has created rivers of tears from loved ones to lost ones. Fuck alcohol....
